1.w: Hallelu YAH! Praise, O servants of YHWH, praise the name of YHWH!

2.w: The name of YHWH be blessed, from now and even to forever!

3.w: From the rising of the sun to its coming in, praised [is] the name of YHWH!

4.w: High over all nations [is] YHWH, [and] over the heavens His glory,

5.w: who [is] like YHWH our God, being on high to dwell,

6.w: stooping down to look on the heavens and on the earth,

7.w: raising up the poor from the dust. He lifts high the needy one from the ash heap,

8.w: to make [him] sit with princes, with the princes of His people,

9.w: settling in a home the barren woman, joyful like a mother of sons. Praise YAH!
